description: This script generates backend stub files for PyTorch, parsing YAML configurations, managing kernel registration, and generating C++ header and source files for dispatching.

classes.name: ParsedExternalYaml
classes.description: Named tuple holding parsed external backend YAML data including backend key, autograd key, class name, namespace, and backend indices.

methods.name: parse_backend_yaml
methods.description: Parses a backend YAML file to create a BackendIndex and related metadata, updating backend indices with external backend info.

methods.name: error_on_missing_kernels
methods.description: Checks for missing kernel definitions in a source file based on expected operator kernels, raising an error if any are missing.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the script, parsing command-line arguments and orchestrating the generation process.

methods.name: gen_dispatchkey_nativefunc_headers
methods.description: Generates C++ header files declaring native functions for a specific dispatch key.

methods.name: gen_dispatcher_registrations
methods.description: Generates C++ source files for registering native functions with the dispatcher for a specific dispatch key.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main function that coordinates parsing YAML, checking kernels, and generating registration code and headers.
